item.title: Eclectic! Love the bathroom. Circa 1929 in Texas. $395,000
item.description: This house looks a bit eclectic. I like the bathroom and the backyard. The house was built in 1929. It is located in El Paso, Texas. The house features wood floors, baseboards, nice fireplaces, crown moulding and a claw foot tub. The home has a basement and a large back deck. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,829 square feet. $395,000 Contact Brenda Rogers with Dream Work Realty: 915-494-6004 From the Zillow listing: Charming and architecturally distinctive home just one block from Madeline Park

item.title: Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! Circa 1860. Two acres. $4,950,000
item.description: Welcome to Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! That old cistern turned wine cellar is pretty cool! The house was built in 1860. It is located on two acres in Covington, Louisiana. The home overlooks Bogue Falaya River and it is situated in the Garden District. There is a beautiful pool, tennis court, pool cabana, beautiful landscaping and an 1860 Canadian dairy barn. Five bedrooms, six bathrooms and 5,051 square feet. $4,950,000 From the Zillow listing: This extraordinary historic esta

item.title: Love the exterior style! Circa 1880 in Vermont. $225,000
item.description: I love the exterior style of this house! The setting seems a bit awkward though. The house was built in 1880. It is located in Chester, Vermont. The house features a nice front porch, large patio with fire pit, wood floors, baseboards and a brick fireplace. The interior could use some character. Just 15 miles from Okemo Mountain. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,327 square feet. $225,000 Contact Joshua Lemieux with RE/MAX Summit: 802-772-0670 From the Zillow listing: Don’t miss this incredible

item.title: So pretty! In the foothills of the NC mountains. Circa 1906. $385,000
item.description: This is such a pretty house! I love the yellow exterior and such a nice porch. The house was built in 1906. It is located on .53 acre in Lenoir, North Carolina. The house features a large covered front porch, pretty front door, beautiful foyer, wood floors, grand staircase, wainscoting, crown moulding, picture rails, bead board ceilings, french doors, wide baseboards, built-in seating, solid wood doors with original hardware, original mantels, claw foot tub, crystal chandelier, built-in china ca

item.title: Potential! On 32 acres in Virginia. Nice creek! $325,000
item.description: This has potential! Nice acreage and a pretty creek! The house was built in 1909. It is located on 32 acres in Stuart, Virginia. That’s a pretty area of Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors and baseboards. Emptying the house out and giving it a good cleaning would go a long way. There are a few outbuildings on the property and Peters Creek meanders through the property. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,064 square feet. $325,000 Contact Warren Rodgers with Warren Rodge

item.title: Pretty waterfall! Cute house! On 35 acres in West Virginia. $330,000
item.description: Pretty waterfall! Nice acreage with this house! The home was built in 1927. It is located on 35 acres in Triadelphia, West Virginia. The house is kind of like a blank slate. I would try to add some character inside. The house features an updated kitchen and bathroom. There is a fire pit area and a covered porch. Pretty setting! Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,044 square feet. $330,000 Contact Missy Ashmore with Old Colony Realtors From the Zillow listing: Build your dream house on 35 acres of

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Six acres in Wisconsin. $150,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Nice acreage! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 6.06 acres in Fall Creek, Wisconsin. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards and a sunroom. There is a detached garage and a detached storage shed on the property. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,664 square feet. $150,000 Contact Brad Kenealy with Chippewa Valley Real Estate: 715-230-9227 From the Zillow listing: Discover the potential of

item.title: Nice interior! Circa 1920 in Wyoming. $224,900
item.description: This house has a nice interior! The property is interesting. The house was built in 1920. It is located Rock Springs, Wyoming. The house features a fenced property, covered front porch, wood floors, built-in bookshelves, leaded glass windows, brick fireplace and a finished basement with a neat stone wall. There is a large backyard with a deck and a detached storage building. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,494 square feet. $224,900 Contact Janell Flack with HOMEroots Realty of Wyoming: 307-38

item.title: A lot of house for the money! Five acres in Alabama. $529,900
item.description: This seems like a lot of house for the money! The house was built in 1922. It is located on five acres in Gadsden, Alabama. The house features a stone exterior, amazing chimney, large back patio, wood floors, paneled wainscoting, soaring ceilings, unique fireplace, huge sunroom, updated kitchen, updated bathrooms and amazing views. There is an attached garage and an in-ground pool. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,076 square feet. $529,900 Contact Susie Weems with Susie Weems Real Estate: 256

item.title: Country living! Seven acres in Arkansas with Pecan Trees. $279,900
item.description: Country living! There are pecan trees on the property. Nice acreage! The house was built in 1932. It is located on seven acres in Earle, Arkansas. The house features a screened in side porch, hardwood floors, big fireplace, crown moulding, baseboards, spacious kitchen with pressed tin ceiling and a bathroom with vintage tile. There is a basement and outbuildings. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,500 square feet. $279,900 Contact Jason Nichols with Cross Country Realty: 501-951-7170 From the Z
